**Texere 0.4.24** · 16 November 2026

- **The map of philosophy, coloured in the graph:** branches, subfields, concepts, theories, movements, periods and authors each get their own colour in the Obsidian graph. The home page offers it with **Add**; your own colour groups stay as they are.
- **Zotero comments reach the note:** the comment of an annotation made in Zotero (or Acrobat, Preview) now goes under its passage in the reading note.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page.
